note: Issue 4514 is a diagnostic-quality issue: the reported symptom IS the error message, quoted verbatim in the issue body. The predicate therefore quotes it verbatim rather than approximating it, which is also what suppresses classify()'s feature-absence demotion -- 'no member named' is one of its invalid-probe markers, so an approximate predicate would have had every reproducing release demoted to invalid-probe and bisect would have reported 'no release could run this repro'. See _predicate_quotes() and SKILL.md's #3055 note. The clause is self-anchoring in both directions: it names the specific namespace and the specific member, so (a) a release that rejected the input before reaching name lookup (unknown profile, unknown flag) cannot emit it, and (b) a shader that never declared testVariable in testNamespace cannot provoke it. Controls: variant-fix-texture (the reporter's own workaround, texture uncommented) and variant-unqualified (hekota's observation) must both score no-match, and variant-global-cbuffer (an ordinary global cbuffer) proves the predicate does not fire on everything.
